items.title: Ph.D. Positions Available | Shenzhen University, China
items.description:
We are recruiting two Ph.D. students to join the research group of Dr. Xinxu Zhang at Shenzhen University. This is an excellent opportunity for motivated candidates passionate about microbiology, immunology, bioinformatics, and environmental science.

📌 Eligibility
Master’s degree (or above) in Microbiology, Immunology, Bioinformatics, Aquaculture, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Environmental Science
Applicants under 40 years of age
Expected graduation certificate accepted (official diploma required before enrollment)

🔬 Research Directions
Deep‑sea microorganisms in carbon & nitrogen biogeochemical cycles
Immune interactions between aquatic invertebrates and microbiomes
Isolation & cultivation of novel archaea and bacteria
Development of probiotics and bioactive substances

💰 Salary & Benefits
Annual salary: 65,000 RMB (~USD 9,330)
Generous scholarships offered after research article publication

📩 How to Apply
Send applications to: rrathour@szu.edu.cn
Priority for candidates ready to begin Ph.D. studies promptly

items.description:

items.title: National Workshop on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Public Health
items.description:
📢 We are pleased to announce a "National Workshop on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Public Health"

The School of Humanities and Social Sciences, IIT Mandi Mandi, in collaboration with the Indian Association for Social Science and Health (IASSH), is organizing a five-day national workshop on:

🤖 “Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning in Public Health: Applications and Responsible AI”
📅 14–18 December 2026
 📍 IIT Mandi, Kamand, Himachal Pradesh

The workshop will focus on building rigorous, interdisciplinary and responsible AI/ML research capacity in public health, covering AI/ML foundations, predictive modelling, classification, model validation, epidemiological applications, deep learning, Natural Language Processing (NLP), generative AI, and responsible AI.

🎓 The workshop is open to faculty members, scientists, PhD scholars and advanced postgraduate students from Public Health, Medicine, Epidemiology, Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering and allied disciplines.

💰 Registration Fee: ₹2,500 (inclusive of food)
 👥 Limited to 40 participants
 🗓️ Registration: 10–25 September 2026
🔗 Register here: https://lnkd.in/d_izfjRm

We invite researchers and scholars interested in AI/ML, public health, epidemiology and data-driven research to participate in this capacity-building workshop.

items.title: PhD Position at Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München in Clinical AI and Medical Data Science
items.description:
📢Job Alert: PhD Position at Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München in Clinical AI and Medical Data Science  

The Institute of Pathology at LMU Munich is one of the largest university pathology departments in Germany. As a key partner of the LMU Medical Center, they provide state-of-the-art pathological diagnostics to the Großhadern and Downtown campuses, as well as to numerous external hospitals and private practices.  

🧑‍🎓Your profile: 
- Master's degree or equivalent in #DataScience, #ComputerScience, #MedicalInformatics, #Bioinformatics, #Statistics, #ArtificialIntelligence, or a related field 
- Strong programming skills in Python and PyTorch 
- Experience in several of the following areas: 
	+ Machine learning and deep learning 
	+ Longitudinal or time-series data 
	+ Large language models or natural language processing  
	+ Transformer architectures and representation learning 
	+ Clinical or biomedical data analysis 
	+ Survival analysis and statistical modeling 
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills 
- Ability to work independently and in an interdisciplinary team 
- Excellent written and spoken English 
- Strong motivation, scientific curiosity, and persistence, with the ability to independently tackle complex and challenging problems 
💶Salary: TV-L E13 (100%) 

⌛Deadline: 2.10.2026 
🔗Details: https://lnkd.in/dmvGTmnS

Apply now!
